title: Evidence Review Assessment
description: Final probabilistic assessment of each finding based on all available evidence sources, including comparison against Node 17's mathematical DST fusion

total_findings.description: Must always be 11 -- the fixed canonical finding count (F01-F11). Does NOT include any UNMAPPED-* entries -- those are counted separately via unmapped_audit_context.

outside_scope.description: Findings outside audit scope (not weakness of finding). Note: outside_scope here refers to review_assessment, not audit_relationship -- a finding can have audit_relationship = Outside Scope while review_assessment is Supported, in which case it should NOT be counted here.

contradicted.description: Findings whose review_assessment is Contradicted -- this includes findings where deterministic validation reported CONTRADICTED, PARTIALLY_CONTRADICTED, or MIXED_SUPPORT_AND_CONTRADICTION.

overall_assessment.description: Overall summary of evidence consistency across all reviewed findings. May reference the existence of unmapped audit context in general terms, but must not attribute it to any specific canonical finding.

review_assessments.description: Evidence-based assessment for each of the 11 canonical findings (F01-F11). Must contain exactly 11 items, one per canonical_finding_id, with no duplicates and no omissions. Must NEVER contain an UNMAPPED-* finding_id -- those belong in unmapped_audit_context instead.

finding.description: Name of the architectural finding, copied from the corresponding Architectural Findings input -- not re-worded.

canonical_finding_id.description: REQUIRED. Copy this value exactly from the matching finding in the Architectural Findings input -- do NOT re-derive, guess, or assign by list position. The 11 canonical findings are: F01 = Upgradeable Proxy Control Risk. F02 = Registry Centralisation Risk. F03 = ACL Manager Role Concentration. F04 = Pool Configurator Centralised Configuration Authority. F05 = Umbrella / Backstop Authority Concentration. F06 = Asset Price Oracle Dependency. F07 = Token Implementation Dependency Risk. F08 = Interest Rate Strategy Dependency Risk. F09 = Flashloan Composability Risk. F10 = Position Manager Trust Boundary. F11 = Reserve Registry Dependency Risk. Every one of these 11 IDs must appear exactly once across the review_assessments array.

severity.description: Severity of the finding, copied from the Architectural Findings input -- not re-assessed here.

review_assessment.description: Overall evidence-based assessment across ALL sources (architecture, deterministic, historical, temporal, audit combined). Must be 'Contradicted' whenever the deterministic validation status for this finding is CONTRADICTED, PARTIALLY_CONTRADICTED, or MIXED_SUPPORT_AND_CONTRADICTION -- never softened to Partially Supported in those cases.

review_confidence.description: Confidence in this evidence-based assessment (0.0-1.0). Reflects evidence quality and agreement, not the finding's own severity or importance. This is your own independent, evidence-based judgment -- reported as a secondary, holistic comparison point alongside Node 17's fused output, not a substitute for it.

audit_relationship.description: How EITHER audit source -- the raw-text Independent Audit, or a Node 13-matched Node 08 audit finding (sources includes NODE_08_AUDIT) -- specifically relates to this finding. A separate axis from review_assessment. Usually 'Outside Scope' since architectural findings are mostly structural and audits are typically implementation-only. It is normal for review_assessment = Supported and audit_relationship = Outside Scope to appear together. If only one of the two audit sources bears on this finding, base the value on that one; do not require both to agree before marking it Supported.

consensus_level.description: Overall agreement between the available evidence sources.

audit.description: True if EITHER audit source (raw-text Independent Audit, or a Node 13-matched Node 08 finding with sources including NODE_08_AUDIT) bears on this finding.

deterministic_status.description: The exact finding-level status copied from Node 16's deterministic validation output for this canonical_finding_id. Required so downstream Node 18 can directly compare this value against Node 16's own record without re-parsing evidence_summary text.

evidence_summary.description: 2-3 sentence summary of what evidence says about this finding

fusion_comparison_note.description: Plain-language comparison of Node 07's raw confidence, Node 16's deterministic evidence, and Node 17's mathematically fused belief/plausibility/BetP for this finding. Explain agreement or divergence; do not recompute, adjust, or contradict Node 17's numbers. Explicitly name two situations when present: (1) divergence.interval_position -- if 'above_plausibility', Node 07's raw confidence exceeded what the combined evidence supports, which is genuinely worth naming; if 'below_belief', this is the structurally expected default whenever Node 16 shows no contradiction and must NOT be narrated as an individually meaningful signal; (2) real Node 16 contradiction (K > 0) that did not proportionally lower Node 17's fused belief -- a known property of Dempster combination where disagreement is absorbed into the conflict value K rather than reducing belief. Do not force either situation into a finding where it doesn't apply. There is no field named interval_contains_baseline -- do not reference it.

unmapped_audit_context.description: One entry for each Node 13 finding whose finding_id begins with UNMAPPED-AUDIT- -- real Node 08 audit findings that could not be matched to any of the 11 canonical findings. Omit this property entirely (or use an empty array) if Node 13 reported no unmapped findings this run. These must never appear in review_assessments.

source_finding_id.description: The UNMAPPED-AUDIT-* finding_id exactly as reported by Node 13.

note.description: Plain-language note stating that real, relevant Node 08 audit evidence exists in this area but could not be matched to a specific canonical finding. Must NOT claim it confirms, corroborates, or changes the assessment of any specific F01-F11 finding.
